# v2.18-dev Release Notes

## Fix: duplicate training options in the requirement picker (and matching under-count)

When adding or editing a **program requirement** (Admin → Program Data → a program), the **Training** dropdown could list the same training name twice. This happens when a training name is backed by more than one catalogue entry (common after imports create separate records that share the same display name).

### What's fixed
- **One entry per training name.** The Training dropdown (and the alternative-training pickers) now show each name **once** instead of a confusing pair of identical-looking options.
- **Requirements now count every variant of the chosen name.** Previously a requirement counted only the exact catalogue record you happened to pick, so anyone who had completed the *other* same-named record was silently missed from the attained total. A requirement now counts a person who holds **any** catalogue variant of the chosen training name (matching how the training catalogue and dashboards already group by full name) — so Country, Region, Theatre, Global, Tier Status, and the Program Compliance Trend all count consistently.

### Notes
- This only changes numbers for training names that have more than one catalogue record — those totals go **up** to the correct distinct-people figure. Names backed by a single record are unaffected.
- No data migration; existing requirements keep working and don't need re-saving.

No action needed after updating.
